description: What each agent CLI needs before it can work: an account sign-in, an API key, or either. keyVariables are the environment variables it reads an API key from; O-BROS only checks whether they are set, never their values. Claude and Codex are handled in their own sections.

agents.title: Gemini CLI
agents.signIn: Run gemini and type /auth to sign in with Google or to use an API key.

agents.title: Qwen Code
agents.signIn: Run qwen and type /auth to sign in, or set an API key.

agents.title: OpenCode
agents.signIn: Run opencode auth login to add a provider, or opencode auth logout to remove one.

agents.title: Kilo Code
agents.signIn: Run kilo auth login to sign in, or kilo auth logout to sign out.

agents.title: Cline
agents.signIn: Run cline auth to sign in or choose a provider and its key.

agents.title: GitHub Copilot CLI
agents.signIn: Run copilot and type /login to sign in with GitHub.

agents.title: Cursor Agent
agents.signIn: Run cursor-agent login to sign in.

agents.title: Amp
agents.signIn: Run amp login to sign in.

agents.title: Factory Droid
agents.signIn: Run droid and sign in when it asks.

agents.title: Kimi CLI
agents.signIn: Run kimi and type /login to sign in.

agents.title: Goose
agents.signIn: Run goose configure to choose a provider and enter its key.

agents.title: Aider
agents.signIn: Set the API key of the provider you use, for example ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then restart O-BROS.

agents.title: Crush
agents.signIn: Run crush and pick a provider, or set its API key.
